1.zh: 作长老的写信给蒙拣选的太太和她的儿女，就是我诚心所爱的；不但我爱，也是一切知道真理之人所爱的。
1.en: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

1.zh: 爱你们是为真理的缘故，这真理存在我们里面，也必永远与我们同在。
1.en: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

1.zh: 恩惠、怜悯、平安从父　神和他儿子耶稣基督在真理和爱心上必常与我们同在！
1.en: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

1.zh: 我见你的儿女，有照我们从父所受之命令遵行真理的，就甚欢喜。
1.en: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

1.zh: 太太啊，我现在劝你，我们大家要彼此相爱。这并不是我写一条新命令给你，乃是我们从起初所受的命令。
1.en: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

1.zh: 我们若照他的命令行，这就是爱。你们从起初所听见当行的，就是这命令。
1.en: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

1.zh: 因为世上有许多迷惑人的出来，他们不认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的；这就是那迷惑人、敌基督的。
1.en: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

1.zh: 你们要小心，不要失去你们所做的工，乃要得着满足的赏赐。
1.en: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

1.zh: 凡越过基督的教训不常守着的，就没有　神；常守这教训的，就有父又有子。
1.en: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

1.zh: 若有人到你们那里，不是传这教训，不要接他到家里，也不要问他的安；
1.en: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

1.zh: 因为问他安的，就在他的恶行上有分。
1.en: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

1.zh: 我还有许多事要写给你们，却不愿意用纸墨[写出来]，但盼望到你们那里，与你们当面谈论，使你们的喜乐满足。
1.en: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

1.zh: 你那蒙拣选之姊妹的儿女都问你安。
1.en: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
